changelog: v0.31.8: nuke leaked BlendShape names from orphan meshes. AssetWatermarkPass made no-op (was creating orphan clones with original BlendShape names). BlendShapeObfuscationPass now ClearBlendShapes on NDMF temp orphans not used by any SMR. AssetNameObfuscation catch-all extended to LoadAllAssetsAtPath for deeper sub-asset coverage. Fixes leaked Breast_, Hairpin_, Foot_ etc. names in assets N.asset files.
